name: Crocolisk Boy and the Bearded Murloc
label: Quest
description: Crocolisk Boy and the Bearded Murloc: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Yebb is working on other attractions for his zoo, including wet, swampy abodes for a boy raised by crocolisks, and perhaps for a murloc. We will need nice, water-tight leggings so we won't get waterlogged during prop-ups and tear-downs. For that job, I think turtlescale leggings will do the trick.
Friend, can you make those leggings? If you do, then a fat stack of Darkmoon Faire tickets will be your reward...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Great, you made them! These will do nicely... I just hope I won't be the one to clean the crocolisk cage when the time comes. Those beasts can be rather beastly, don't you think?
Here are your tickets, friend. Enjoy them, and enjoy your stay at the Darkmoon Faire!
